title: Home guide: evaporation patches
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: States of matter (Marvellous Medicine and How Far Can Sound Travel?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 3 (Home practical guide and safety card: evaporation patches (portal worksheet))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out where water evaporates fastest.
equipment: A damp cloth and two plates
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Wipe the damp cloth across each plate to make a wet patch the same size.
Put one plate by a sunny window and one in a shady corner.
